title: recall/initialize params
description: Version range plus a writable workdir. Negotiation happens once, here.

workdir.description: Writable directory under Recall's state directory. An adapter writes indexes and checkpoints only here.

source_id.description: Display name this instance is configured under. Locator text is <source_id>:<local>. Not identity; the core overwrites the source part of every returned locator.

location.description: Configured path, endpoint, or connection reference for this source instance.

base_dir.description: Directory of the file that declared this source. Settings is adapter-owned, so configuration cannot resolve paths inside it; an adapter resolves settings paths against this rather than the process working directory.

settings.description: Adapter-owned settings, shaped by the manifest's settings_schema.
